defs.def: one part in every hundred 百分之 …adjectiveadverb

ex.s: Be demanding on yourself and expect 100 percent attention to the task.
ex.t: 对自己严格要求，期待百分之百的注意力投入到任务中。

ex.s: In a study published Wednesday in Environmental Science & Technology Letters, researchers from China found that boiling tap water for just five minutes — then filtering it after it cools — could remove at least 80 percent of its microplastics.
ex.t: 在周三发表于《环境科学与技术快报》的一项研究中，中国研究人员发现，将自来水煮沸仅五分钟——冷却后过滤——可以去除其中至少80%的微塑料。

ex.s: In the study, boiling hard water containing 300 milligrams of calcium carbonate led to an almost 90 percent drop in plastics.
ex.t: 在该研究中，煮沸含有300毫克碳酸钙的硬水可使塑料含量下降近90%。

ex.s: But in samples with less than 60 milligrams of calcium carbonate, boiling reduced the level of plastics by just 25 percent.
ex.t: 但在碳酸钙含量低于60毫克的样本中，煮沸仅使塑料水平降低25%。

ex.s: A survey found that 29 percent of college students registered for online courses.
ex.t: 一项调查发现，29%的大学生注册了在线课程。

ex.s: By the early 1970s, after centuries of cruel and continuous hunting by settlers, 600 to 800 grizzlies remained on a mere 2 percent of their former range in the Northern Rockies.
ex.t: 到20世纪70年代初，经过定居者数百年来残酷而持续的猎杀，灰熊只剩下600到800头，仅分布于北落基山脉昔日活动范围的2%。

ex.s: New researchers found that middle-aged women who were physically fit could be nearly 90 percent less likely to develop dementia in later life, and as they did, it came on a decade later than less sporty women.
ex.t: 新研究发现，身体健康的中年女性晚年患痴呆症的可能性可能降低近90%，而且发病时间比不太爱运动的女性晚十年左右。

ex.s: Five percent of the highly fit women developed dementia, compared to 25 percent of the women with medium fitness and 32 percent of the women with low fitness.
ex.t: 5%的高度健康女性患上痴呆症，相比之下中等健康女性为25%，低健康女性为32%。

ex.s: In the past ten years, one percent of our company’s profits ____ given to local charities.
ex.t: 在过去十年中，我们公司百分之一的利润____捐给了当地慈善机构。

ex.s: In fact, most people only absorb about 20 percent of a speaker’s message.
ex.t: 事实上，大多数人只能吸收演讲者信息的20%左右。

ex.s: It’s been reported that 76 percent of employees in some western countries are using emojis at work.
ex.t: 据报道，一些西方国家76%的员工在工作中使用表情符号。

ex.s: By spreading cheese brine on streets before adding a layer of rock salt, Milwaukee may be able to cut its rock salt use by 30 percent.
ex.t: 通过在铺岩盐前先在街道上撒奶酪卤水，密尔沃基可能将其岩盐使用量减少30%。

ex.s: In the study, about 52 percent of the dads exhibited above-average levels of authoritative parenting. key finding is that over time, children raised by an authoritative father were significantly more likely to develop persistence, which leads to better outcomes in school.
ex.t: 这项研究发现，约52%的父亲表现出高于平均水平的权威型育儿方式。一个关键发现是，随着时间的推移，由权威型父亲抚养的孩子更有可能培养出坚持不懈的品质，从而在学校取得更好的成绩。

ex.s: A new report found 46 percent of meals are eaten alone in America.
ex.t: 一份新的报告发现，在美国46%的餐食是独自进食的。

ex.s: More than half（53 percent）have breakfast alone and nearly half（46 percent）have lunch by themselves.
ex.t: 超过一半（53%）的人独自吃早餐，近半数（46%）的人独自吃午餐。

ex.s: Only at dinnertime are we eating together anymore，74 percent，according to statistics from the report.
ex.t: 只有晚餐时我们才会聚在一起吃饭——74%，根据该报告的统计数据。

ex.s: The number of trees larger than two feet across has declined by 50 percent on more than 46, 000 square miles of California forests, the new study finds.
ex.t: 一项新研究发现，在加利福尼亚州超过46,000平方英里的森林中，直径超过两英尺的大树数量已经减少了50%。

ex.s: In the Sierra high country, the number of big trees has fallen by more than 55 percent; in parts of southern California the decline was nearly 75 percent.
ex.t: 在内华达高海拔地区，大树的数量下降了超过55%；在南加州部分地区，下降幅度接近75%。

ex.s: Pupils at about 90 percent of British secondary schools wear uniforms.
ex.t: 约90%的英国中学生就读的学校要求学生穿校服。

ex.s: Corn production has jumped nearly 125 percent over   62   past 25 years, while rice has increased only 7 percent.
ex.t: 玉米产量在过去25年里飙升了近125%，而水稻仅增长了7%。

ex.s: According to the World Bank, China accounts for about 30 percent of total   67   (globe) fertilizer consumption.
ex.t: 根据世界银行的数据，中国约占全球化肥消费总量的30%。

ex.s: In America the demand for oil has grown by 22 percent since 1990.
ex.t: 自1990年以来，美国对石油的需求增长了22%。

ex.s: Twenty percent of the lost items are claimed in three months’ time.
ex.t: 20%的遗失物品会在三个月内被认领。

ex.s: More than 23 percent of adults and 80 percent of adolescents don't get enough physical activity, and according to a 2019 report from the World Health Organization.
ex.t: 超过23%的成年人和80%的青少年缺乏足够的身体活动，根据世界卫生组织2019年的一份报告。

ex.s: While 78 percent of parents said they believed they were good screen time role models, the study found a disconnect between their behavior and their perception of their behavior.
ex.t: 尽管78%的父母说他们认为自己是良好的屏幕时间榜样，但研究发现他们的行为与其对自身行为的认知之间存在脱节。

ex.s: To be sure, more than half of teens still engage in these activities, but the ___44___ have slimmed considerably, Between 1976 and 1979, 86 percent of high school seniors had gone on a date; between 2010 and 2015 only 63 percent People say, Oh, it's because teenagers are more responsible, or more lazy, or more boring, “but they're ___45___ the larger trend,” said Jean Twenge, lead author of the study, which drew on seven large time-lag surveys of Americans.
ex.t: 可以肯定的是，超过一半的青少年仍参与这些活动，但比例已大幅缩减。1976至1979年间，86%的高中生约会过；2010至2015年间只有63%。人们说，哦，这是因为青少年更负责任、更懒惰或更无聊，但"他们顺应了更大的趋势，"该研究的主要作者让·特温格说，该研究利用了七项针对美国人的大型时滞调查。

ex.s: In 1990, immigrants numbered some 1.14 million out of Italy’s then 56.7 million people, or about 2 percent.
ex.t: 1990年，移民人数约为114万，占当时意大利5670万人口的2%左右。

ex.s: At the start of this year, foreigners living in Italy amounted to 4.56 million of a total population of 60.6 million, or 7.5 percent, with immigrants’ children accounting for an even larger percentage of births in Italy.
ex.t: 今年年初，居住在意大利的外国人达到456万，占总人口6060万的7.5%，其中移民子女在意大利出生人口中所占比例更高。

ex.s: 74  The synapses in the mice taken at the end of a period of sleep were 18 percent smaller than those taken before sleep, showing that the connections between neurons weaken while sleeping.
ex.t: 这就是为什么学生在学习后有机会睡觉的话考试表现会更好。

ex.s: Its population has crashed by as much as 90 per cent in the last few years.
ex.t: 在过去几年里，其数量锐减了高达90%。

ex.s: Despite a weight of up to 300 kilograms, they can run at a speed of around 64 kilometers per hour and are also excellent swimmers.
ex.t: 尽管重达300公斤，但它们能以大约每小时64公里的速度奔跑，同时也是出色的游泳者。

ex.s: FRESHWATER PROBLEMS in Africa by 2025 * Freshwater shortage (less than 1,000 m3/capita/year) * Freshwater stress (1,000 to 1,700 m3/capita/year) * Globally, renewable internal freshwater resource per capita was around 6,000 m3 in 2014.
ex.t: 到2025年非洲的淡水问题 * 淡水短缺（人均每年少于1000立方米） * 淡水紧张（人均每年1000至1700立方米） * 全球范围内，2014年可再生内部淡水资源人均约为6000立方米。

ex.s: He used donated funds and his own money to pay the 50 pounds per child that the British government required.
ex.t: 他用捐款和自己的钱来支付英国政府要求的每个孩子50英镑的费用。

ex.s: Antarctica holds about 90 per cent of the world’s ice, with most of its fresh water in a frozen state.
ex.t: 南极洲拥有全世界约90%的冰，其大部分淡水处于冰冻状态。

defs.def: following sth that has been decided 每；每一

ex.s: You will work on a morning, afternoon or evening shift at your project site for 3 to 5 hours per day, Monday to Friday.
ex.t: 你将在项目现场工作早班、午班或晚班，周一至周五每天3到5小时。

ex.s: Ribeiro ___44___ €35 per person for what is usually a three-course meal that can last up to three hours.
ex.t: 里贝罗对通常可长达三小时的三个菜的西餐每人收取35欧元。

ex.s: Completing many courses no longer brings out the feeling of success because more than four AP classes per year is a norm set by top universities.
ex.t: 完成许多课程不再带来成功感，因为每年四门以上的AP课程是顶尖大学设定的常态。

ex.s: As a result, since 1996 a group of insurance companies have spent about $2 million per year on the Alberta Hail Suppression Project.
ex.t: 因此，自1996年以来，一组保险公司每年在阿尔伯塔冰雹抑制项目上花费约200万美元。

ex.s: The average spend per project will be around £ 823.
ex.t: 每个项目的平均花费约为823英镑。

ex.s: •Fees: $365 per week.
ex.t: •费用：每周365美元。

ex.s: The day is divided into two thematic sessions per age group.
ex.t: 每天按年龄组分两个主题时段。

ex.s: 40 hours per week during the summer break.
ex.t: 暑假期间每周40小时。

ex.s: 20 hours per week during the semester.
ex.t: 学期期间每周20小时。

ex.s: 2 jobs, each with 16 hours per week.
ex.t: 2份工作，每份16小时/周。

ex.s: 3 jobs, each with 2 hours per week.
ex.t: 3份工作，每份2小时/周。

ex.s: Failure to provide enough chaperones will result in an extra charge of $50 per absent adult.
ex.t: 如果未能提供足够的陪同人员，每位缺少的成人将额外收费50美元。

ex.s: A special low entrance charge of £2 per person is available to all in full-time education, up to and including those at first degree level, in organised groups with teachers.
ex.t: 所有全日制学生（包括本科在内）在有老师带领的团体中可享受每人2英镑的特殊优惠票价。

ex.s: Fruit juices, milk-based drinks and most alcoholic drinks are free of the tax, as are small companies manufacturing fewer than 1m litres per year.
ex.t: 果汁、含乳饮料和大多数酒精饮料免税，年产量少于100万升的小公司也免税。

ex.s: It turns out that pet transporting pays quite well at about $30, 000 per year before tax.
ex.t: 事实证明，宠物运输收入相当可观，税前每年约3万美元。

ex.s: Tickets: £7.50 per session
ex.t: 门票：每场7.50英镑。

ex.s: According to her research, runners hit the ground with as much as four times their body weight per step, while race walkers, who do not leave the ground, create only about 1.4 times their body weight with each step.
ex.t: 因此，她说，跑步相关的一些伤害如跑步膝等在竞走运动员中并不常见。

ex.s: Farming produced more food per person ___58___ hunting and gathering，so people were able to raise more children.
ex.t: 而且，随着更多孩子的出生，更多的食物   ___59___(被需要)。

ex.s: In Save Money: Good Food, she visits a different home each week and with the help of chef Matt Tebbutt offers top tips on how to reduce food waste, while preparing recipes for under £5 per family a day.
ex.t: 在《省钱：美食》节目中，她每周拜访一个不同的家庭，并在厨师马特·泰布特的帮助下，提供如何减少食物浪费的顶级建议，同时制作每天每户不超过5英镑的食谱。

ex.s: The average number of electronic devices rose from four per household in 1992 to 13 in 2007.
ex.t: 电子设备的平均数量从1992年的每户4台增加到了2007年的13台。

ex.s: But the amount of time spent in reading each session has declined, from closer to an hour or more to closer to a half hour per session.
ex.t: 但每次阅读的时间已经减少，从接近一小时或更多减少到接近每次半小时。

ex.t: 它使用一个23加仑的油箱飞行，在空中每小时消耗5加仑燃料。

ex.t: 在地面行驶时，每加仑可行驶35英里。
